summary: The PR addresses the issue of non-disjoint cycles in the Permutation constructor but may introduce behavioral changes and lacks comprehensive testing.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior of the Permutation constructor when non-disjoint cycles are provided, which could break existing code that relies on the current error-raising behavior.
There are no additional tests added to verify the new behavior of handling non-disjoint cycles, which is critical for ensuring the correctness of the change.
